Detailed Description: Core system to schedule and automatically publish posts, reels, and videos. Primary publishing on Facebook with automated cross-posting to Instagram.
Ingest post performance metrics (Reach, Engagement). Use AI to extract learnings and suggest content improvements for future campaigns.
Robust infrastructure supporting 50+ automated accounts. Integrates residential proxies, session management, and anti-detect browser mechanics to safely automate Reacts, Comments, and Shares.
Configure unique 'Tone of Voice' and persona profiles for individual seeding accounts to ensure organic, context-aware comments generated by AI.
Automated pipeline using Remotion to generate dynamic short-form videos and highlights based on incoming data and AI suggestions.
Automated generation of static visual assets (banners, social cards) using programmatic tools (Satori, Sharp, ComfyUI).
Auto-generate post captions, hashtags, and call-to-actions tailored by the AI learnings derived in Stage 1.
Automated scrapers to pull trending posts, metrics, and content from specific Facebook Pages, Groups, and keyword searches.
Filter, clean, and organize scraped Facebook data into a structured format to act as raw material for Stage 2 Content Generation.
